The cast

The first fourteen bodies are outlines with a face. The cast are someones: each has parts that move on their own, a temperament, a register, and in some cases a second body it becomes.

Who they are#

CreatureWhat it isTemperamentParts and habits
foxThe sly one: tall ears, cheek fluff, a brush of a tail with a pale tipsly (smug, looks away)tail that trails behind every move
pangolinThe guardian: plated armour in a smooth materialstoicplates; rolls into a ball on error and to sleep
owlThe scholar: brow tufts, big eyes, folded wingsscholar (slow blinks, no hopping)its head turns right round while it thinks
axolotlThe support agent: pink, blushing, gillscuriousfrills that fan out when it listens and droop when it is sad
jellyThe ambient companion: a glass belldreamy (floats)tendrils that hang, sway and lag
mothThe night companion: fuzzy, dazeddrawn (floats)wings that flutter while it thinks, feathery antennae
sproutThe one that grows: seed, hatchling, growneagera lifecycle blended by age; a sprig that grows
octoThe orchestrator: eight armsbusyan arm lights up for every running tool (observe('tool'))
toasterThe applianceperkya slot, a lever, and toast that pops on success
snailThe patient one: eyes on stalks, a shellpatient (slow)retreats into its shell on error and to sleep
cometThe fast-mode mascot: a lantern starshowOff (spins)a streak that lengthens with speed
swarmThe crew: dots that gather into one shapehive (floats)the swarm material; scatters when it is low
orbThe serious family: a glass sphereserene (floats, still)no face until it speaks, reacts or looks (faceOn: 'talk')
glyphThe monochrome line familyprecise (snap blinks)the line material: an outline in its colour, light on dark pages

Use them like any type: <bot-avatar type="owl">, createBot(el, { type: 'octo' }). Each brings its own defaults (the jelly is glass, the comet a lantern, the glyph a line); anything you set wins. identity keeps the draw it always had, so an id keeps its bot (an id that drew a retired shape gets that shape's successor).

Parts#

A part is drawn round the body in one of three layers (painted on it, behind it, in front of it) and moves from the pose: trailing parts lag with a spring the simulation runs, wings and frills beat faster when the bot is busy or airborne, arms light up with running tools, a popup rises on success, a shell shrinks away as the body morphs. The kinds: tail, tendrils, wings, frills, arms, shell, plates, slot, popup, sprig, knob, spiral, streak. Parts are plain data on the creature, so they travel to the drawing threads and into exports.

Bodies that change#

A creature can have another outline it becomes in some states (morph): the pangolin's ball, the snail's shell. The body blends between the two over a moment, keeping its fur. A creature can also have a lifecycle (stages): the sprout is a seed at age: 0, a hatchling at 0.5, grown at 1. Age is yours to keep (a count of sessions, days since it hatched); pass it back and it grows.

<bot-avatar type="sprout" age="0.2"></bot-avatar>
<bot-avatar type="orb" state="speaking"></bot-avatar>   <!-- the face appears -->

Your own creature#

The built-in cast lives in src/creatures/, one module each, and registerCreature() takes the same format:

import { registerCreature, geometry } from '@kucukkanat/bots';
const { circle, poly, polarUnion, chaikin } = geometry;

registerCreature({
  type: 'newt', label: 'Newt', color: '#7BC9A5', faceY: 0.1,
  outline: () => chaikin(polarUnion([circle(0, 0.1, 0.8), poly([[-0.9, 0.4], [-0.2, 0.9], [-0.9, 0.9]])]), 2),
  extras: { parts: [{ kind: 'tail', anchor: [0.5, 0.6], side: 1, len: 0.9, width: 0.22 }] },
  temperament: 'nervous',                              // or bring one: temperaments: { skittish: { motion: {…}, face: {…}, shy: 1 } }
  defaults: { eyeStyle: 'dot', shading: 'smooth' },
  morph: { states: ['sleeping'], outline: () => polarUnion([circle(0, 0.05, 0.85)]) },   // curled up to sleep
});
createBot('#x', { type: 'newt' });

Outlines are closed point lists in a box of about −1..1 (y down), resampled to 200 points from the top centre, so a morph outline lines up with the main one. Habits a temperament can carry: aloof, shy, float, snap, showOff, swivel.
